query: I had the most amazing matcha latte at the new café down my street this morning, they even added a little cat-shaped foam art on top that I almost didn't want to drink. On my way home I ran into my old college roommate, we ended up chatting for almost half an hour about her upcoming hiking trip to the Rockies next month. Oh, and my cat just knocked over a potted succulent on my windowsill, I still haven't cleaned up the soil off the floor yet.
